Optimum Coal Workers

By: Joy Summers | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

Unique Selling Point:
As the business rescue process drags on, workers have gone months without being paid, and despite promises of relief on February 28, some remain sceptical...and the Guptas still haunt the sale of the bankrupt mine

Summary:
and now, the fact that business rescue practitioners closed down operations has made the mine unsafe...explosion kills 22 zama zamas

Script:


Optimum2019 final script with Promo’s TX Sunday 17 Feb 2019

Gloria shaft. Koornfontein mine Mpumalanga

Commentary One
Just over a week ago, 22 cable thieves climbed down through these huge air vents and into the mine. The vents are fitted with enormous fans and provide fresh air underground. From up here nothing seems out of place, but on the ground, this site is a crime scene.

Mike Elliott Koornfontein COO
This is the outer cover of these cables, they are massive cables. This is the armouring that protects it against getting hurt and all they want is those three copper cores out of the centre of the cable

Commentary Two
Michael Elliott is Koornfontein’s chief operating officer

Mike Elliott
This is the twin overhead powerline over here. What they do is they cut the poles and the steel stay wire. The weight of the overhead powerline snaps the poles, puts them on the ground and trips out the Eskom power, they then cut through the copper cables that connects the overhead power lines to the transformers behind us. This is 22 000 volts coming here – once the power tripped out we can’t see at nighttime….metal merchants

Commentary Three
They also knocked out power to the entire mine, and destroyed the transformer

Mike Elliot
When our security and the police react they go to one area, these guys strip in another area and when the police and our security get to the area they are going to defend, these guys evaporate into the darkness

Commentary Four
In this battle against organised crime, the mines, Eskom and the workers are all losing out

Mike Elliot
It’s incredible because we can’t just start up the mine again, we now have to go and spend R50 million to fix it

Commentary Five
By cutting the electricity, the cable thieves underground had inadvertently sealed their own fate.

Mike Elliot
As soon as the fans stopped running, the methane gas bubbles out of the coal…roof and because the mine is stagnant it starts to collect. These guys were about a kilometer to the north and somehow they ignited the gas underground and there was an explosion

Commentary six
The explosion, about a kilometer away blasted the doors of the vents open-

Flash wipe with explosion

but this latest assault on the Optimum mine complex was not the first.

Up sound music

In June 2016 Carte Blanche exposed how Eskom executives helped the Gupta’s company Tegeta buy Optimum, its export entitlement, and its sister mine Koornfontein with an irregular R600 million rand prepayment

At the time we filmed these Optimum aerials, Gupta management had only been in their offices for three months and the mine was still operational

Devi Link
But that picture has changed completely. The Gupta’s left destruction in their wake, and the future of this mine hangs in the balance

Commentary seven
Now it’s under business rescue and Louis Klopper is one of the practitioners. For 12 months he has followed the money trail.

Louis Klopper
The amount of money they took out of that mine …if they had invested in that mine that would have been the flagship coal mine in SA Today
Devi
It happened in such a short space of time
Louis
Two years. I am on record as saying to the Parliamentary committee that these people didn’t come to do business, they came here to steal, and I am still of that conviction.

Commentary eight
Eskom’s generous prepayment wasn’t the only favour they did for the Gupta’s.
Koornfontein mine, was included in the Optimum deal and soon after, Eskom awarded this mine with a R7 billion rand coal contract

Miner Arcenior Vilankulu worked underground there.

Devi
So tell me what happened when the Gupta’s got involved
Arcenior
Whew! We were working with criminals. They are smooth talkers they tell you what you want to hear

Commentary nine
But the miners soon realized this was mining, Gupta style.

Arcenior
Ok we were getting paid, but you could see this ship is going down – its sinking slowly, slowly -the ship is going down
Devi
Because you can’t cut corners in mining?
Arcenior
Exactly. You cut corners people will die, it’s that simple. They just wanted their coal

Commentary ten
Gupta executives pushed their miners hard to increase production, but refused to spend money on essential maintenance

Devi
Did they buy any new machinery?
Never!

Commentary eleven
On the Optimum mine Dirk Volschenk drove these huge drag liners.

Dirk
The bakkies we drove to the machines that was in a terrible state, sometimes you will drive and one wheel would sommer come off.

Commentary twelve
Working drag liners were stripped for spares

Louis
The equipment we are talking about was production equipment, which they butchered. If they were short of a part on one machine they stripped it from another ….the other two machines going

Commentary Thirteen
Skimping on their machines was one thing, but the Guptas also put the safety of their miners at risk

Dirk
There was no gloves, overalls and goggles. It was just terrible

Commentary fourteen
It was the same story underground

Arcenior
Underground its dusty, you have to put dust mask. If no dust mask you can’t go underground
If the valor light the light that shows ok there is ventilation underground is not functioning we cannot go underground
Devi
You mean things as serious as that?
Arcenior
There were at time we cant go underground yes .
Devi
And then when the guys say we are not going underground then what
Arcenior
Then they will try by whatever means to find whatever
Scratching around?
Arcenior
Scratching and then we find and then we work

Commentary fifteen
The Guptas claim that whilst they operated the mine, they complied fully with safety regulations. By February last year no bank would operate an account for any Gupta company, that meant trading recklessly, so seven of their companies went into business rescue.

Arcenior
At least we were being rescued. At least we were no longer in Gupta’s hands

Commentary sixteen
Klopper was under huge pressure to evaluate if the businesses could be saved. Optimum, they concluded could be rescued, but the state of the mines was shocking

Louis
Absolute disaster, absolute mess

Commentary Sixteen A
Not so according to the Guptas who claim that they ran the mine very successfully. They accuse the business practitioners of running the business into the ground and being paid massive profits

Louis
Absolutely nonsense our fees are highly regulated ….and our books are open

Commentary
The Gupta’s have now brought an application to court to have them removed.
Louis claims that this is just a continuation of the saga of over 40 other cases based on similar spurious claims that were all dismissed with costs.

Link
Once the mine was in the hands of the Business rescue practitioners – their job was to stabilize the finances and find a buyer as quickly as possible. They also started to investigate where all the money went.


Louis
It was very clear from an investigation into the books that there was wholesale theft of cash
Devi
So did they use Optimum mine as a cash cow from the very beginning?

Louis
Yes. Millions of rand’s transferred from Optimum to Oakbay, just a simple transfer of millions of rand’s with no documentation
Devi
It seems to me you are describing fraud?
Louis
By the Gupta companies? Absolutely! No other word for it

Commentary seventeen
The Gupta’s deny this. When it became clear to the business rescue guys that the Gupta’s were trying to hold onto the mines through front companies, they say they were barred by the Gupta’s from entering these offices

Devi
Are the Guptas trying to sabotage the sale of Optimum?
Louis
It appears so, because Oakbay is not going away with their court applications preventing us from selling this mine. It’s very clear they are still taking instructions from Dubai

Commentary eighteen
Klopper believes the Gupta’s are behind 80% of the cases they have had to fight. And that delayed the sale of the mines. Money dried up, and the miners lost faith in them

Arcenior
In the beginning we thought it would be better but eventually we see there is nothing different here, these Gupta’s and BRP there is no difference

Commentary nineteen
For three months now the miners have not been paid. Cars, homes, even lives have been lost. Feed the miner was started by two local women who saw how desperate things had become. Zonica Mostert is one of them

Zonica
We try to give out parcels every second week, but now we started weekly.

Devi
What was December like for you?
Arcenior
Whew! December was like black, black Friday

Dirk
All the credit cards and savings are up now ..this month the rent I don’t know – you can look in cupboards we depend on feed the miners

Commentary Twenty- one
Late on Wednesday rescue efforts for the cable thieves got underway. Families waited anxiously outside the mine.

Devi
How much has the rescue operation cost thus far?
Mike
Its cost close on to a million rand

Commentary Twenty- two
Seven bodies were recovered before the teams were recalled. Dangerous gasses made it impossible to continue. But the miners are furious rescue efforts of cable thieves seem more important than their own hardships

Arcenior
When we crying nobody came to us. To be heard you must be a thief, or have to be a criminal! The person has rights is the criminal

Commentary Twenty- two
Now as time, money and patience have run out, the sale of these once proud mines are more important than ever.

Louis
We are working on our plan B. We should have a solution shortly
Devi
And shortly is three months four months?
Louis
Within the next month, we have to, we have no choice

THE END Duration 11 12.

PROMO ONE 10 seconds
In 2016 the Gupta’s bought Optimum mine. Two years later it was in Business rescue. Now the miners haven’t been paid and the situation there, is desperate

PROMO TWO 15 seconds
Meet Louis Klopper, Business rescue practitioner of Optimum mine owned by the Gupta’s
Devi
So, did they use Optimum mine as a cash cow from the very beginning?
Yes
how did you know that was the plan?
Louis
Millions of Rands transferred from Optimum to Oakbay, just a simple transfer of millions of Rands with no documentation


PROMO THREE 15 seconds

Commentary One
Just over a week ago, 22 cable thieves climbed down through these huge air vents and into the Koornfontein mine, wreaking havoc in their path

Mike Elliott Koornfontein COO
This is the outer cover of these cables, they are massive cables. This is the armouring that protects it against getting hurt and all they want is those three copper cores out of the centre of the cable


PROMO FOUR 30 seconds
When the Gupta’s bought Optimum mine, they pushed production but skimped on maintenance and safety say the miners
Arcenior
Ok we were getting paid, but you could see this ship is going down – its sinking slowly, slowly -the ship is going down
Devi
Did they buy any new machinery?
Never!
Dirk
The bakkies we drove to the machines that was in a terrible state, sometimes you will drive and one wheel would sommer come off.
